marketing.trustLead: [[brand]] protects accounting workflows with access controls, secure sessions, auditable records, and a clear roadmap toward third-party assurance. We do not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FTA accreditation until those reviews are complete.
marketing.trustPosture1: High/critical production dependency audit gate is part of release.
marketing.trustPosture2: Automated test, build, type-check, and migration-secret gates run locally.
marketing.trustEvidenceBody: Release evidence is kept practical: automated gates, production health checks, and authenticated route crawls for protected firm workflows when smoke credentials are available.
marketing.trustEvidence1Body: Type-check, unit tests, API contract checks, dependency audit, and production build run before release promotion.
marketing.trustEvidence2Body: Read-only smoke checks cover liveness, readiness, deployed version, and OAuth-provider response on the production URL.
marketing.trustEvidence3Body: Authenticated firm-route smoke is supported with dedicated smoke credentials and recorded as internal release evidence.
marketing.trustControl1Body: Customer workspaces require signed-in access, scoped company membership, and role-aware route checks.
marketing.trustControl2Body: Session handling uses httpOnly cookies, token revocation, CSRF protection for cookie requests, and startup secret validation. Users can review and sign out individual devices.
marketing.trustControl3Body: Optional TOTP two-factor sign-in with single-use recovery codes. Company owners can require it for owners and admins or for every member, and sensitive actions ask for a fresh code.
marketing.trustControl4Body: Sensitive operational settings are separated from the public app surface, stored secrets and in-app backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and encrypted transport is expected in production.
marketing.trustControl5Body: Security events, postings and chart-of-accounts changes are written to an append-only audit log whose entries are linked by SHA-256 hashes; owners can verify the chain and export it with before/after values.
marketing.trustRolesBody: Seven company roles (owner, admin, accountant, bookkeeper, approver, employee, viewer) each hold an explicit list of permissions. The server checks them on every request, so a viewer stays read-only and one company's records answer as not found to another company.
marketing.trustActivityBody: Every posting, voiding and settings change is recorded with who did it and when. Owners, admins, accountants and approvers can read the history; viewers and employees cannot.
marketing.trustOperationalBody: The public posture separates working product controls from environment-specific operating procedures and future certifications.
marketing.trustOp1Body: The application backup flow creates checksum-verified snapshots and offers restore previews. Restores run in one transaction. An automatic safety backup is taken before a Replace restore only. Operational backup cadence is confirmed for each production environment.
marketing.trustOp2Body: The response checklist covers containment, audit-log review, key/API-token rotation, recovery from backup when integrity is in question, and UAE PDPL notification review.
marketing.trustOp3Body: The Privacy Policy is public. Enterprise DPA and security-questionnaire review is handled during onboarding while a standard downloadable DPA pack is prepared.
marketing.trustSupportBody: Paid plans include guided onboarding, implementation checklists, and support through the onboarding team. Formal enterprise support commitments are confirmed during setup based on the active hosting and support configuration.
marketing.trustExpect2: Migration support from Mazeed, Wafeq, Zoho Books, or Excel exports.
marketing.trustExpect3: Escalation path for accounting workflow blockers during onboarding.
marketing.trustExpect4: Security and data-processing questions answered before enterprise activation.
marketing.trustRoadmap1: Publish formal uptime and incident-response history once enough production traffic has been measured.
marketing.trustRoadmap2: Complete an independent external penetration test on a stable production release (not yet performed).
marketing.trustRoadmap3: Prepare SOC 2 / ISO 27001 readiness evidence once operational controls have live history (no audit has been performed and no certification is held).
marketing.trustRoadmap4: Publish a detailed data-processing statement under UAE PDPL with counsel (a draft data map exists).

marketing.migrationWafeq4: Import current-period bank statements and reconcile from the migration date forward.

marketing.migrationChecklistBody: This checklist is the minimum we recommend before moving real books from another platform.
marketing.migrationCheck1: Pick a go-live date and stop editing old books after that date.
marketing.migrationCheck2: Export all source-system reports before cancelling competitor accounts.
marketing.migrationCheck3: Reconcile opening bank, AR, AP, VAT, and retained earnings balances.
marketing.migrationCheck4: Run one test invoice, receipt, VAT summary, and bank import before live use.
marketing.migrationCheck5: Keep source-system backups for the statutory retention period.
marketing.migrationFilesBody: The Import data wizard loads CSV exports from Xero, QuickBooks Online, Zoho Books and Wafeq: chart of accounts, opening trial balance, customers, vendors, items, open invoices and open bills. Bank reconciliation supports CSV formats from Emirates NBD, ADCB, FAB, Mashreq, and generic statement layouts. Prior-system report packs from Mazeed, Wafeq, Zoho Books, or Excel should be stored in Document Vault as read-only support files.
marketing.migrationBankBody: Import bank statements from the go-live date forward, review suggested matches, and create journal entries only for transactions that are not already represented in the opening balances.

marketing.hxFaqDeadlineQ: When is the UAE e-invoicing deadline?
marketing.hxFaqDeadlineA: General information, not advice: businesses with annual revenue under AED 50 million appoint an accredited service provider by {smallAppoint} and go live on {smallLive}. For AED 50 million or more the dates are {largeAppoint} to appoint and {largeLive} to go live. A late-implementation penalty of AED {penalty} per month applies. Check the Ministry of Finance and FTA announcements for your case.
marketing.hxFaqEinvA: {brand} prepares each invoice in the PINT AE format. E-invoices are exchanged through an accredited service provider, built into {brand}, on the Peppol network. E-invoicing is included on every plan.
marketing.hxFaqVatA: Prepare and review VAT 201 in {brand}, then submit it in EmaraTax.
marketing.hxFaqAcctQ: Can my accountant work in my books?
marketing.hxFaqAcctA: Yes. Invite your accountant with the role that fits their work. Accounting firms can work across several client companies and share documents through the client portal.
marketing.hxFaqRecordsQ: Can I bring my existing records?
marketing.hxFaqRecordsA: Yes. Import supported records from CSV files, and follow our migration guides for Excel, Zoho Books, Wafeq and Mazeed.
marketing.hxFaqCardQ: Do I need a card to try it?
marketing.hxFaqCardA: No. Start a 14-day free trial of the Enterprise plan without entering card details.
marketing.hxFaqCancelA: Yes. You may cancel at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, as set out in our Terms.

marketing.hxHubFaq1Q: Who has to use e-invoicing in the UAE?
marketing.hxHubFaq1A: B2B and B2G transactions are in scope, on dates that depend on your annual revenue. Businesses that only sell to consumers (B2C) are currently out of scope. Check the Ministry of Finance for the latest rules.
marketing.hxHubFaq2A: PINT AE is the UAE data format for e-invoices, built on the Peppol international standard.
marketing.hxHubFaq3Q: Do I need to appoint a provider myself?
marketing.hxHubFaq3A: E-invoices are exchanged through an accredited service provider, built into {brand}, so you set it up from Settings instead of integrating one yourself. Check the Ministry of Finance guidance for what applies to your business.
marketing.hxHubFaq4A: {brand} is the accounting software where you create and review your invoices. E-invoices are exchanged through an accredited service provider, built into {brand}.
marketing.hxHubFaq5A: E-invoicing is included on every plan, with no separate e-invoicing subscription from {brand}. Check the terms shown during setup for anything else that may apply.
marketing.hxHubFaq6Q: What happens if I miss the deadline?
marketing.hxHubFaq6A: The Federal Tax Authority publishes a late implementation penalty of AED {amount} per month. See the official pages for the details.
